ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Animals, Naturally
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Rebalances animals against one another using biological reference values.
Every value is derived from a single physical anchor: the species' real mass in kilograms.
- Body size: the cube root of mass relative to a 70 kg human. This rule was checked against the real masses of 54 vanilla species, with a 7 percent median error. - Lifespan: allometric laws calibrated by clade. A parrot, chicken, and sparrow do not follow the same curve: a macaw lives for 55 years, while a chicken lives for 7. - Hard rules: retaliation is at least as likely as taming failure; trainable animals do not escape their pens; maximum prey size accounts for hunting method. - Hybridisation: groups derived from real taxonomy in Dogs Mate format.
Precautionary rule: a value changes only when it differs from its target by more than 15 percent. Ludeon's existing hand-tuning is not overwritten when it is already close, deliberately oversized creatures retain their intended size, and apex predators retain the maxPreyBodySize = 99999 sentinel.
All patches are conditional: removing an animal mod simply makes its corresponding patches inert, without load errors.
Load AFTER all animal mods.
IF I GO QUIET: If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
AI-GENERATED: Claude (Anthropic) and Codex (OpenAI) assisted with the XML patches, tests, documentation and audit maintenance. The values and rules are mine.
